supportBacklog.label: Shared frame atlas variants
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current primitives do not provide a single reusable frame variant set for all required support panel sizes and state labels.
supportBacklog.trigger: At least two additive screenshot sets show unresolved frame-role mismatch after current-asset composition.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 0 additive screenshot proof and missing-role approval
supportBacklog.notes: Support-only output; no scenic owner transfer.

supportBacklog.label: Plaque / ribbon / title-plate family
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current bars and blocks do not cover a reusable cross-screen title and badge carrier role with consistent hierarchy.
supportBacklog.trigger: Cross-screen additive captures confirm unresolved header/label carrier role after preserve-enhance pass.
supportBacklog.deliverableType: reusable plaque and ribbon support parts
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 0 proof and explicit missing-role approval

supportBacklog.label: World / building label plaques
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: World and routed building surfaces lack a reusable diegetic label carrier role that preserves city and room scenic ownership.
supportBacklog.trigger: World/building additive screenshots show unresolved label grounding role with current assets.
supportBacklog.notes: Support labels only; no city repaint or room repaint.

supportBacklog.label: Overlay / mask pack
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current shell layers lack reusable compositing masks needed to apply legibility emphasis consistently across multiple surfaces.
supportBacklog.trigger: Additive compositions across multiple screens still show unresolved compositing role after preserve-enhance usage.
supportBacklog.deliverableType: reusable alpha overlay and mask parts
supportBacklog.notes: Cannot be used to hide unresolved layout or truth-surface issues.

supportBacklog.label: State underlays / recommendation swashes / tracked stamps
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current chips and bars do not supply a reusable state-marking substrate for recommendation and tracking states across screen families.
supportBacklog.trigger: At least two surfaces retain unresolved state readability gaps after additive preserve-enhance implementation.
supportBacklog.deliverableType: shared state underlay and stamp support kit
supportBacklog.notes: Must remain subordinate to existing semantic icons and labels.

supportBacklog.label: Shared FX sprite atlas
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current assets do not provide a unified reusable FX vocabulary that supports high/low/reduced operation modes consistently.
supportBacklog.trigger: Atmosphere role remains missing after static support layers are in place and verified across quality modes.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 1 support completion and Wave 0 proof
supportBacklog.notes: FX cannot be used as substitute for unresolved structure.

supportBacklog.label: Cultivation hero enhancement overlays
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current center stack lacks reusable additive emphasis layers for hero focus while preserving existing cultivator and dantian semantic owners.
supportBacklog.trigger: Approved additive cultivation/prestige screenshots still show unresolved hero-emphasis support role.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 1 and Wave 2 completion with explicit owner-preservation proof
supportBacklog.notes: No base center replacement is permitted.

supportBacklog.label: Heart Law altar / seal support kit
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: Current Heart Law compositions lack a reusable sacred-focus support kit that can frame altar/seal states without replacing doctrine shells.
supportBacklog.trigger: Heart Law additive captures retain unresolved sacred-focus support role after preserve-enhance pass.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: Wave 1 support completion and approved role-gap evidence
supportBacklog.notes: Support kit only; no repaint of existing heart-law owners.

supportBacklog.label: Optional medallions / icon seals
supportBacklog.missingRoleStatement: After functional support roles are complete, optional reusable ornament seals may still be missing for non-critical ceremonial accents.
supportBacklog.trigger: Only evaluated after core support backlog closure and explicit non-critical ornament gap confirmation.
supportBacklog.blockedUntil: All core support families resolved and not blocked
supportBacklog.notes: Never a prerequisite for Phase 1 support-art progress.
